title: crypto2dev_aead.c: register gcm(aes), ccm(aes)
description: Register AES-GCM and AES-CCM as kernel AEAD algorithms. .cra_name='gcm(aes)' and 'ccm(aes)', driver names 'wolfkm-gcm-aes' and 'wolfkm-ccm-aes', priority 300. Implement .setkey, .setauthsize, .encrypt (generate auth tag), .decrypt (verify tag — return -EBADMSG on failure). wolfCrypt's streaming API handles the scatterlist with AAD prepended. Only use sg_copy_to_buffer as fallback if wolfCrypt scatter API has a gap — cap at 64 KB, reject larger inputs with -EMSGSIZE.
design: GCM tag sizes: 4, 8, 12, 16 bytes (setauthsize validates). CCM nonce sizes: 7-13 bytes. Decrypt MUST return -EBADMSG (not -EINVAL) on tag mismatch — kernel AF_ALG and IPsec/xfrm depend on this exact errno. AAD is passed via the scatterlist ahead of the ciphertext in the kernel AEAD API. Read include/crypto/aead.h carefully before implementation. See DESIGN.md §aead.
acceptance_criteria: /proc/crypto shows gcm(aes) and ccm(aes) with wolfkm driver at priority 300. IPsec xfrm AES-GCM-128 tunnel test passes. Tampered ciphertext returns -EBADMSG. Variable tag sizes 4-16 bytes all work.
close_reason: Stale: from abandoned kernel-crypto-API-registration design. crypto2dev does not register into kernel crypto API (wolfcrypt.ko does that). Current implementation uses chardev+provider model instead.
